_doc: Recorded upstream package pins as of the last cel-spec vendor refresh. The drift checker (scripts/check-cel-spec-drift.py) compares these to the live pins in packages/contracts/pyproject.toml and packages/contracts-typescript/package.json. Bumping either package WITHOUT updating both this file and tests/conformance/cel/vendor/cel_spec_vectors.json triggers VAL-W6-055 drift failure.
